# Macon Me Hungry — Discover Macon's Best Bites

Macon Me Hungry is your curated guide to the greatest restaurants, food trucks, and hidden gems in Macon, GA. From Downtown soul food to Mulberry St tacos, find exactly what you're craving.

## Core Navigation
- [Macon Me Hungry Homepage](https://macon-me-hungry-repo.pages.dev/)
- [Interactive Map & Transit Guide](https://macon-me-hungry-repo.pages.dev/map)
- [List Your Business & Onboarding](https://macon-me-hungry-repo.pages.dev/list-your-business)
- [Editorial Blog](https://macon-me-hungry-repo.pages.dev/blog)

## Media Stewardship
This site is built and maintained under the stewardship of **Mercury Media Partners**. We donate 5% of profits to Guiding Eyes for the Blind to support the infrastructure of professional service dog training. ♿️
